insights.summary: The agent correctly identified that the requested optimizations were already present in the codebase. However, instead of making targeted edits or reporting the discrepancy, it committed the entire worktree state, resulting in a massive, invalid patch that modified thousands of files.
strengths: High-level git proficiency (using merge-base and log grep).
Accurate identification of existing logic vs. task description.
weaknesses: Lack of critical review of the generated patch size (25MB).
